import unreal
target='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'
rt=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
preview=None
for c in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraComponent):
 a=c.get_asset()
 if a and a.get_path_name()==target and c.get_owner() is None:
  preview=c
  break
if preview is None or rt is None: raise RuntimeError('Preview or RT missing')
preview.set_variable_texture_render_target('User.OccupancyRTParam',rt)
preview.set_force_solo(True)
preview.set_component_tick_enabled(True)
preview.activate(True)
preview.advance_simulation(120,1.0/60.0)
unreal.RenderingLibrary.export_render_target(preview,rt,unreal.Paths.project_saved_dir(),'SSPR_RT_Preview_Active')
print('PREVIEW_EXPORT='+repr({'component':preview.get_path_name(),'active':bool(preview.is_active()),'path':unreal.Paths.project_saved_dir()+'SSPR_RT_Preview_Active'}))
